facts.text: Jolene has been struggling to find a good work-life balance during her internship.

evidence.quote: Finding that balance has been tough. I've been slogging away and it's been hard to make time for my hobbies and chilling out.

evidence.quote: Yeah, I'm trying to do it. Here's an example of how I spent yesterday morning, yoga on top of mount Talkeetna.
It looks like it's really helping you regroup and recharge.
